observed.detail: MetaMask Account 1 connected on Sepolia; no signature or transaction was submitted.
A free HTTPS Agent metadata record was saved to the wallet-scoped browser registry and a duplicate record was removed.
Draft validation and transaction-state preview completed; the UI explicitly reported that no wallet transaction was sent.
A six-node DAG was generated, revised manually, and started. Execute used Kimi K2.7 Code and Judge used Kimi K2.7 Code Highspeed. The run remained running beyond the bounded observation window.
The dashboard explicitly identified fixture data and unavailable offline request lookup.
The linear 6 percent test-yield calculator reacted to slider input; the transaction action remained disabled.
The conflict declaration control was clicked but produced no visible status change.
The page identified local-only readiness and unavailable external telemetry.
